newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE targets 4,500 level after U.S. rally.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE targets 4,500 level after U.S. rally.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index opened sharply higher on Tuesday, leaping above the 4,500 level for the first time after a blistering rally in the U.S. sent the Dow to a record close.

But shares struggled to hold on to opening gains after the UK Treasury announced that the monthly monetary meeting between new Chancellor Gordon Brown and Bank of England governor Eddie George had been brought forward to Tuesday.
By 0748 GMT the FTSE 100 index had sliced its gains to be up 29.2 points at 4,484.8, after setting a new peak of 4,501.1 at the start of business. Gainers led decliners by 77 to 15.
